meta.title: The Bohemians: Bohemian Music Festival 2027 · Danube Delta
meta.description: The Bohemians Festival 2027 — boutique house, deep house & tech house festival in the Danube Delta. 5th edition, June 2027, Sfântu Gheorghe, Romania. Join the list for dates & early tickets.
meta.ogDescription: Boutique house, deep house & tech house festival in the Danube Delta — wild nature, intimate stages, where the river meets the sea. 5th edition · June 2027.

schema.eventDescription: House, deep house and tech house festival in Sfântu Gheorghe, Danube Delta. 18–21 June 2026. Limited capacity.
faq.q1: How do I get to the festival?
schema.faqA1: By car or bus to Murighiol or Tulcea, then by boat to Sfântu Gheorghe (45–90 min). Full details in the Venue section of the website.
schema.faqA2: No. The festival ticket is separate from accommodation. Options include Green Village Resort, Green Dolphin Wooden Houses, and Green Dolphin Camping.
schema.faqA3: 18 years old by the date of the festival.
faq.q4: Can I come with a tent?
schema.faqA4: Yes. Green Dolphin Camping has 500 spots. Booking details for 2027 will be announced together with the festival dates.
faq.q5: Is it safe to come alone?
schema.faqA5: Yes. The festival has a curated crowd, discreet security, and a community that respects each other. After four editions, the safety of attendees remains our top priority.
faq.q6: When do tickets for 2027 go on sale?
schema.faqA6: Dates and tickets for the 5th edition will be announced soon. Join the mailing list on the website to hear first and get early access.

about.label: The Organiser
about.heading: Who We Are
about.questions:
Do you love art and beauty?
Is nature your home?
Are you longing for music, freedom, and connection?
about.p1: Welcome to The Bohemians — a music & travel festival set in one of the wildest and most poetic places in Europe, right where the river meets the sea.
about.p2: For four days and four nights, we gather a like-minded community to celebrate music, nature, and the joy of being fully present.
about.soul: The kind of place you'll try to explain and fail.
venue.label: Location
venue.heading: Where Does the Festival Take Place?
venue.body: A fishing village at the end of the oldest arm of the Danube, right where the river meets the Black Sea. You can't get here by car. And that's exactly what makes it special.
venue.carText: Drive to Murighiol or Tulcea, then take a boat transfer lasting 45 to 90 minutes.
venue.busText: Eurolines runs direct coaches to Murighiol. From there, take a boat to Sfântu Gheorghe.
venue.boatNote: "The boat ride isn't an inconvenience — it's the first part of the experience."
stay.label: Where to Stay
stay.intro: The ticket does not include accommodation. Book directly with the venues below — the partner booking code for 2027 will be announced together with the dates.
stay.alt1: Green Village Resort wooden cabins on the Danube Delta in Sfântu Gheorghe
stay.text1: The most complete resort in the Delta. Pool, restaurant, real comfort by the water.
stay.alt2: Green Dolphin wooden houses on stilts in Sfântu Gheorghe, Danube Delta
stay.text2: Authentic wooden cabins in the heart of the Delta. Simple, warm, exactly what you need.
stay.alt3: Green Dolphin camping tents pitched in nature at Sfântu Gheorghe, Danube Delta
stay.text3: Closest to the stage, closest to the stars. 500 tent spots on the waterfront.
stay.alt4: Private guesthouse accommodation in Sfântu Gheorghe village, Danube Delta
stay.text4: Stay with locals in the village of Sfântu Gheorghe. Authentic delta experience, steps from everything.
act.label: Off Stage
act.heading: What to Do at the Festival
act.d1: Guided boat excursions through the Delta's canals in search of Europe's rarest birds.
act.d2: SUP sessions on calm lakes in the morning, before the music begins.
act.d3: Sfântu Gheorghe is an old fishing village on the Sulina arm of the Danube, right where the river meets the sea. Worth exploring on foot.
act.d4: Wild beach, fine sand, sunset straight into the sea. No sunbeds, no crowds, no noise.
act.d5: Morning sessions in the open air, surrounded by nature. Reset before the music takes over.
act.d6: Explore the Delta at your own pace — by kayak through the canals or by bike across the island.
pack.label: Practical Info
pack.heading: What to Pack
pack.d1: The Delta sun is intense. Bring SPF 50 and reapply often.
pack.d2: Nights by the water get cold, even in June. A light jacket is essential.
pack.d3: Card terminals are limited in the village. There are no ATMs in Sf. Gheorghe.
pack.d4: You'll walk on sand, grass, and cobblestones. Pack both shoes and sandals.
pack.d5: Wild beach five minutes from the venue. Don't miss the sunset swim.
pack.d6: Village streets have no lighting at night.
pack.d7: You're in the Danube Delta. Mosquitoes are part of the experience.
pack.d8: Refill points available on-site. Less plastic, better Delta.
pack.d9: Nearest pharmacy is in Tulcea, 90 minutes away by boat.
